liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Music Never Stopped** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles it out as the show's real highlight, full of power and glory; Reviewer heard it on a radio show and found its energetic solo the best version they knew [8][10][18]
- **Cold Rain & Snow** (2 reviews): The opener is described as crisp, played in a Madison February; Reviewer's favorite Dead opener, and calls this version great [8][19]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Garcia's attacks are called cosmic, with a seamless transition into Eyes of the World and a mellow groove; The band starts to hit full stride with Estimated into Eyes [11][12]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Garcia's solo is described as flawless, quoting Weir's phrase about it being exactly perfect [8]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Segue from Estimated is effortless, with a monster intro to Eyes featuring special notes from Jerry [14]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Playin>Wheel>Playin has some of Garcia's best 1978 improvisation, including a passage with minimal backing, mostly Phil chords [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-02-03.164050.aud.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1978-02-03.164048.akg.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 171 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd78-02-03.aud.warner.19465.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 4.28/5 by 25 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience tape is decent but has mechanical issues, including a cut, and the loop back into Playin' is cut; Jerry is very prominent in the mix; Reviewer deducts a star for sound quality [12][14][16]
- **gd1978-02-03.164049.akg.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 171 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found the show via WEQX radio's 'The Dead Zone', which played The Music Never Stopped [10]
- Attendee recalls a crowd full of flannel in the big Madison hall, which warmed up quickly [17]
- Reviewer finds less passion than 1-22-78, and ranks 7-8-78 as tops for 1978 Estimateds [15]
- This source is nearly complete, lacking the cuts of the circulating audience source, and includes the Johnny B. Goode encore [2]
- Show appears on Dick's Picks 18 [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-02-03.164050.aud.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes (unknown equipment) > PCM > Tim McKenzie's DAT (16/44.1) [1]. Also: Mono source from Tim McKenzie's DAT, transferred by Charlie Miller; same as shnid 19465, patched, pitch corrected, one generation less; AKG source supplies crowd sound and the opening seconds of several songs, including Mexicali Blues, They Love Each Other and Passenger [1]
- **gd1978-02-03.164048.akg.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Tim McKenzie; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; AKG mics > unknown deck > 1st generation cassettes > Tim McKenzie's 2nd generation cassettes [2]
- **gd78-02-03.aud.warner.19465.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [5]. Also: Dick's Picks 18 used The Music Never Stopped and the Estimated through Playin' sequence from this show, plus the next two shows; Master audience cassette of unknown gear, then PCM, DAT, CD, extracted and encoded to shn [5][16]
- **gd1978-02-03.164049.akg.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Tim McKenzie; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; AKG mics > unknown deck > 1st generation cassettes > Tim McKenzie's 2nd generation cassettes [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gdnotebook.blogspot.com: [1973-10-25 - Dane County Coliseum](https://gdnotebook.blogspot.com/2010/11/1973-10-25-dane-county-coliseum.html) [21]
- Fan art by recordsale.de: [Dick's Picks, Vol. 18: Dane County Coliseum - 2/3/78; Uni-Dome, University Of N. Iowa - 2/5/ - The Grateful Dead | Recor](https://recordsale.de/en/artists/the-grateful-dead/albums/dick-s-picks-vol-18-dane-county-coliseum-2-3-78-uni-dome-university-of-n-iowa-2-5) [22]
